name: Street Justice
description: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Headlock
features.description: Your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against a creature Grappled by you.

features.name: Sturdy Knot
features.description: When you use Chain, Manacles, or Rope to bind a creature, add your Proficiency Bonus to the DC to escape or burst the Chain, Manacles, or Rope.

features.name: Tough Talk
features.description: A creature’s Hostile attitude doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your Charisma (Intimidation) checks to influence that creature.
